summary: Frontend E2E for Phase 3 (Vampire's Choice, Vite+React 19+TS, client-only). Verified all PRIORITY 1/2/3 items post content externalisation. Book Complete flow (new gothic screen, saved-note, teaser, return button, bottom-nav hidden) works. Continue on completed book routes to Book Complete (not finale). Persistence across reload holds. Alt lectern branch loads Isolde crypt scene from JSON. State screens + Settings reset OK. Zero console/page errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Book Complete screen implementation is clean and adheres to the gothic aesthetic (Cinzel/Cormorant fonts, crimson/gold accents, dark bg) - matches rest of app.
Externalising Book 1 to JSON via loader.ts + typed model preserves runtime engine contract; branching parity vs Phase 2 confirmed end-to-end (Lucian and lectern paths).
Completion state routing (activeScreen='book_complete') and BottomNav hiding on that screen work as designed; migration to SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION=3 does not break existing sessions.

Minor (carried from Phase 2): achievement banner is a fixed overlay that can intercept Playwright coordinate-based force clicks; use DOM .click() in automation. Consider pointer-events tuning for mobile UX.
Consider auto-focusing the RETURN TO THE LIBRARY button on Book Complete for keyboard/A11Y.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use DOM .click() via page.evaluate() for choice buttons to avoid interception by the fixed achievement-unlocked banner overlay. Book Complete screen testids: book-complete-screen, book-complete-saved-note, book-complete-next-teaser, book-complete-return-btn. Continue-on-completed-book routes to Book Complete (this is the new correct behavior).
